scheme_name: Chetan Chauhan Labor Sports Promotion Scheme
other_conditions: Worker must be employed in an establishment registered under the Factories Act, 1948
Monthly salary (basic + dearness allowance) must not exceed ₹15,000
Worker must have worked continuously for at least six months in the establishment/factory and be in service at the time of applying
Benefit is admissible only to the worker or his two daughters (or two children)
Only players selected on or after 23 March 2021 are eligible
Female workers who are players themselves are also eligible
benefits_summary: One-time financial assistance ranging from ₹25,000 to ₹1,00,000 per son/daughter based on the level of sporting achievement (district, state, national, or international).
documents_required: Scanned copy of the verified application form
